    <style>
        :root {
            --dgBG: #e5eff8e5;
            --dgColor: black;

        /*-----------------------------*/
        #gridContainer .dx-datagrid-headers {
            color: var(--dgColor) !important;
            background-color: var(--dgBG) !important;
        }

        #gridContainer .dx-datagrid-borders>.dx-datagrid-total-footer {
            border-top: 4px solid var(--dgBG);
            border-bottom: 4px solid var(--dgBG);
        }

        #gridContainer .dx-datagrid-borders>.dx-datagrid-headers {
            border-top: 4px solid var(--dgBG);
            border-bottom: 4px solid var(--dgBG);
        }

            border-left: 4px solid var(--dgBG);
            border-right: 4px solid var(--dgBG);
        }

        /*.dx-datagrid-total-footer {
            background-color: var(--dgBG) !important;
        } */
        #gridContainer .dx-datagrid-filter-panel {
            background-color: var(--dgBG) !important;
        }

        /*-----------------------------*/
        #popupBenefitsView .dx-popup-wrapper>.dx-overlay-content {
            border-radius: 9px
        }

        .title-bg {
            background-color: rgba(191, 191, 191, 0.15);
        }

        .second-group {
            background-color: rgba(191, 191, 191, 0.15);
        }

        .colorRED {
            color: #9e030b !important;
        }

        .colorBGlightgrey {
            height: 130px;
            width: 650px;
            /*padding-top: 30px;*/
            padding: 20px;
            background-color: #f5f4f4 !important;

        }

        .colorRBGlightgrey {
            border: 1px solid rgb(163, 162, 162);
            height: 90px;
            width: 300px;
            padding-top: 2px;
            padding: 2px;
            color: rgb(0, 0, 0);
            background-color: #f5f4f4fa !important;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        #gridContainer .dx-datagrid-headers {
            color: #000000 !important;
            background-color: var(--dgBG) !important;
        }

        #popupBenefitsView .dx-datagrid-headers {
            color: #000000 !important;
            background-color: var(--dgBG) !important;
        }

        #gridContainer .dx-scrollable-scroll {
            height: 180px !important;
        }

        .dx-scrollable-customizable-scrollbars ::-webkit-scrollbar:horizontal {
            height: 180px;
        }

        .dx-scrollable-customizable-scrollbars ::-webkit-scrollbar:vertical {
            width: 180px;
        }

            overflow: hidden;
        }

            background-color: black;
